name: dish-menu-morph
title: Dish Menu Morph
description: A menu page that cycles through three dishes: a three-line icon morphs into the next dish's line art, the headline letters slide out and in, the dish illustration flies off at 45 degrees and back, and the menu items slide up with their prices.
useWhen: A restaurant or food stall promo should step through its signature dishes with prices.
A menu section needs a tidy swap animation between items.
avoidWhen: You need real food photography: this block draws simple illustrations (use product-grid-reveal for photos).
The menu has many items per dish.
author: oliviale
